t: A father's advice to his son
a: يَـٰبُنَىَّ أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأْمُرْ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَٱنْهَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَكَ ۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ
p: Yā bunayya aqimi-ṣ-ṣalāta wa'mur bi-l-maʿrūfi wa-nha ʿani-l-munkari wa-ṣbir ʿalā mā aṣābak…
m: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] resolve.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
